name: Nexusify
description: Router that credits $25 of usage every Monday with no card and a 130 rpm cap.
overview: Nexusify exposes 99 text models — Gemini, GPT, Llama, Mistral, Grok, DeepSeek and more — through one OpenAI-compatible endpoint at api.nexusify.co/v1. Every account gets $25 in free credits that renew every Monday, with no card to start and a 130 requests-per-minute ceiling; paid credits only draw after the free ones run out and never expire. Sign-in is by Google, Discord or CAPTCHA. Image models sit on the same key at a flat per-request price.
free_access: No card to start; Google, Discord or CAPTCHA login
99 text models on one OpenAI-compatible endpoint
notes: Credits are denominated in dollars, not tokens; $25/week buys far more on a small model than on a frontier one.
